I later realized that shiny server might actually used forked processes to manager workers, so creating fork cluster in 
hosted shiny app may not be a good idea.

I have tested with mclapply method in hosted app before and that didn't meet problem. However I'd like to keep the option of 
clusters when app can be run locally in windows.

Is it possible to detect if the app is running locally or hosted from within the app itself? I found Sys.info returned this

                                                login 
                                            "unknown" 
                                                 user 
                                              "shiny" 
                                       effective_user 
                                              "shiny" 

Can I use the "user: shiny" as a reliable method to detect app running platform?
